name: D no Hi Shou! Drone de Nozoki! Netorare ADV
original_name: Dの秘翔!ドローンで覗き!寝取られADV
source:
Peek into a high-rise apartment building with a drone! Seek out seductive scenes!

Our protagonist uses a high-performance drone to peek into a classy condo building.
Walk around the park or shopping district, find your target, and learn their apartment number.
3 heroines - an energetic high school girl, a neat office lady, and the protagonist's wife.
Spy on their naughty moments. Watch the stories take unexpected turns!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ257893.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
用无人机窥视高层公寓楼！寻找诱人的场景！

我们的主角使用高性能无人机窥视一栋优雅的公寓楼。
在公园或购物区走走，找到你的目标，并了解他们的公寓号码。
3位女主角——精力充沛的女高中生、整洁的白领女士和主角的妻子。
监视他们的顽皮时刻。观看故事发生意想不到的转折！
